0.Note: Qualifying: #4 time disallowed for deflecting air off the window net

1.Note: #8 leads the field to green from the outside, #19 inside.  #8 initially gets a jump before #19 fights back on the backstretch.

2.Note: A third lane forms on the outside led by #20 near 12th, it is able to make some progress and #20 runs 6th at the line

3.Note: #6 gets a big run on the inside and shoots up to a 3-wide battle for 2nd alongside #22 and #19.

4.Note: Inside lane has now shrunk to just two cars, #42 and #97.  #42 is able to get a big run off turn 4 and takes the lead, clearing in front of #8

5.Note: Caution:  #78 spins in turn 4 from 24th and makes contact with #45.  #40 and #24 also make wall contact, while #66 and #4 hit each other avoiding the accident.

6.Note: #24, #4, #40 come to pit road for repairs

8.Note: All lead lap cars except #8 (2nd), #77, #71, #1, #23, #51, #7, #41, #16, #84, #47 pit.  #22 gets off pit road first followed by #42 and #19.

10.Note: Sixteen cars come to pit road to top off.  The only car who did not pit during that caution was the leader #8.

12.Note: Restart:  #8 leads from the outside, #22 inside.  #22 gets a push on the backstretch, allowing him to clear #8 for the lead.  He then jumps in front of #8 in the outside lane.

13.Note: #22 drops to block the lower lane, allowing #8 to pull alongside in a battle for the lead.

14.Note: #22 jumps to the outside lane, allowing #42 to get under him

17.Note: Inside lane has slowly inched forward, with both #42 and #6 clear of the field.  #21 battles #22 for 3rd

19.Note: #22 pulls alongside #42 to battle for the lead.  The entire field is running at approximately 50-75% throttle.

27.Note: #42 continues to lead as #6 and #22 battle for 2nd.

33.Note: #42 and #22 have been exchanging the lead as the field continues to mostly run double file

34.Note: A 3rd lane on top begins forming led by #97 near 10th in turn 1.  #54 and #19 join the chain allowing #19 to go three-wide for the lead off turn 4

35.Note: #22 drops to the bottom lane in front of #42, middle lane led by #8 has slightly faded back to 5th

37.Note: #8 gets sideways near 8th off turn 4 and touches #6.  #6 is forced off track but both cars recover and continue

39.Note: #19 and #22 have cleared the field while #42 and #54 run side-by-side for 2nd

45.Note: #19 and #22 try to block each of the three lanes.  #6 has recovered from his save to battle for 3rd in between #42 and #45

48.Note: Outside lane has begin to slowly pull ahead, with top 4 running single file (#19, #54, #97, #9)

50.Note: #8, #10, #21, #16 pit.  #16 lightly taps #10 exiting pit road as both avoid #8 exiting his stall but all continue without trouble.

53.Note: Field shuffles behind #19, with the top 9 now running single file on the inside lane

57.Note: #24 gets a bad push from #97 while running 7th on the backstretch and bounces off the outside wall.  He continues but falls back to 15th.

58.Note: #19, #11, #23, #35, #54, #43, #67, #20, #45, #84 pit.  #84 spins coming to pit road but is able to keep going.

61.Note: #23 hits the back of #5 in turn 4 causing #5 to get sideways, but everyone saves it and continues.

65.Note: #38 wins stage 1 followed by #2, #12, #77, #17.  This is the first career stage win for #38

66.Note: #51 free pass.  #21 comes to pit road

67.Note: #4, who finished stage 1 in 10th, slows and appears to be out of fuel on the backstretch but makes it back to pit road with help from #21

68.Note: All lead lap cars except #43, #47, #16 pit.  #77 gets off pit road first followed by #12 and #17.  #42 locks his tires and gets sideways into his stall.  #54 stops in the #11 pit after leaving his stall to tighten a left front lugnut,  #38 leaves his stall with a wrench stuck in his grill.  Two penalties:  #35 over the wall too soon, #54 pitting outside his box
#23 and #11 now run side-by-side for the lead as #38 leads the top lane near 9th

72.Note: Restart:  #12 leads from the outside, #2 inside.  #2 gets a push and clears #12 to take the lead.

75.Note: #11 gets a push to take the lead and jumps in front of #2 off turn 2.  #23 leads the inside lane and gets alongside #2 to battle for 2nd

78.Note: #23 and #11 now run side-by-side for the lead

80.Note: #51 gets a push from #5 to take the lead.

81.Note: #1 gets alongside #51 to battle for the lead

82.Note: #23, #51 and #1 battle three-wide for the lead before #1 is able to clear the field and block all three lanes.

83.Note: #40 gets alongside #1 to battle for the lead.

85.Note: Caution:  #88 and #40 make contact off turn 4 battling for 2nd and a chain reaction occurs.  #51 gets sideways and hits #88 who spins.  #19 and #54 also spin, #19 gets hit by #3 on pit road.  Cars involved:  #1, #3, #19, #34, #40, #51, #54, #67, #88.

88.Note: All lead lap cars pit.  #1 gets off pit road first followed by #5 and #11.  #48 has to back up in his stall, #2 gets forced halfway onto the grass exiting pit road.

90.Note: #47, #42, #16 pit to top off on fuel

92.Note: Restart:  #1 leads from the outside, #5 inside.  #1 and #11 both clear for the lead and 2nd.

94.Note: #2 gets a push on the inside lane and briefly leads before #1 shoots back.  #38 leads the top lane to make it 3-wide for 2nd.

95.Note: #2 and #1 jump in front of #38 in the top lane

96.Note: #2 leads #17 and #12 who have all cleared the field

98.Note: #97 gets under #1 to battle for the lead

100.Note: #1 leads at halfway.  Only twice in the last 33 Daytona 500s has the halfway leader gone on to win (Denny Hamlin - 2016 & 2020)

103.Note: #5 gets a push from #8 on the inside lane and gets alongside #97 to battle for the lead

106.Note: #8 gets the lead on the inside lane after #5 goes up in front of #97

108.Note: Richard Childress Racing has passed 1,000 career laps led in the Daytona 500, the third team in history to do so

109.Note: #8 and #5 lead both lanes and remain side-by-side for the lead

113.Note: #8 has been consistently edging ahead of #5 for most of the lap before #5 charges back.

118.Note: #8 and #12 both clear #5 and move to the top lane

120.Note: #11 gets alongside #12 briefly to battle for 2nd before #12 fights back

121.Note: #11 gets alongside #8 to challenge for the lead in turn 1 before fading

122.Note: #11 clears #8 for the lead off turn 4 and moves up in front of him in the outside lane.

123.Note: #40 gets gets under #11 and passes for the lead in turn 3.

124.Note: Caution:  #11 and #40 make contact and spin in the tri-oval battling for the lead, triggering a multi-car crash.  Total cars involved:  #1, #2, #5, #8, #11, #12, #22, #24, #34, #35, #38, #40, #41, #42, #43, #48, #54, #67, #71, #97

131.Note: All lead lap cars pit.  #23 gets off pit road first followed by #67 and #17.  Penalties:  #51 pitting outside his box, #16 too fast exiting

136.Note: Restart:  #23 leads from the outside, #67 inside.  #23 gets a push ahead off turn 4.

138.Note: #20 tries to lead a 3rd lane on the outside from near 5th in turn 1 but can't make any progress.  #67 and #23 remain side-by-side

139.Note: #20 finally gets alongside #23 and #67 to battle for the lead

142.Note: Field continues in a 3-wide formation, led by #20 (top lane) #23 (middle lane) and #67 (inside lane)

144.Note: #23 and #67 have pulled ahead of #20, who now runs alongside #17 and #35 battling for 3rd

145.Note: #20 gets back alongside #23 and #67 in a 3-wide battle for the lead

158.Note: #20, #23 and #67 continue to run three-wide for the lead as the field runs mostly in fuel save mode

164.Note: #67 has led 8 laps so far today.  The last time a car numbered 67 led this many laps:  Jim Reed at Thompson, CT - 1951

165.Note: #20 moves to the bottom lane, allowing #41 to lead the outside lane. #23 leads the middle lane and is clear of the other two lanes

175.Note: #23 drops down to the bottom lane in front of #20.  #17 now leads the middle lane and runs 3-wide with #23 and #41

180.Note: #17 pulls alongside #23 to battle for the lead as green flag stops are imminent

185.Note: #41 runs out of gas on the backstretch running 4th.  #17, #21, #4, #6, #45, #60, #42, #16 all pit.  #1 now leads

189.Note: #22, #12, #38 pit.  #6 leads the cars that have pitted so far, followed by #4 and #17

191.Note: #6 and #17 now lead the cars that have pitted

192.Note: Caution:  #20 and #11 make contact battling near 11th exiting turn 4, causing both to hit the outside wall.  #67, #43 and #60 also make wall contact behind them.

193.Note: We have had 23 leaders today, a new record for the Daytona 500

195.Note: #71, the only car yet to pit, states they are not pitting under the yellow

197.Note: Restart:  #71 leads from the outside, #45 inside.  #45 gets the lead in turn 1 and he and #24 clear the field in turn 2.  #45 tries to block both lanes allowing #71 to go outside.  #24, #45 and #71 run 3-wide for the lead off turn 4

198.Note: #71 and #77 clear the field in turn 1.  #22, who restarted 14th, surges to 4th on the backstretch.  #71 and #77 lead the field off turn 4.

199.Note: #77 gets a great run on the backstretch and passes #71 for the lead.  #77 leads at the white flag.

200.Note: Exiting the tri-oval, #43 bumps #77, causing #77 to spin which triggers a multi-car crash that collects #77, #43, #71, #42, #10, #12, #41, #67, #84, #1, #60, #16, #54.  #9 emerges as the leader on the backstretch but #45 gets a huge run in turn 4 and moves from 3rd to 2nd, then gets alongside #9 for the lead entering the tri-oval.  Coming to the checkered flag, #45 pulls ahead as a crash collects #6, #35, #22, #9, #47.  #45 wins by 0.308 seconds over #47.
